Spark 4.1.3 · generated 2026-09-26T22:09:06 · every choice is selected on **validation** data (TEST is left for ZR-3's final table). The winner of each choice is the highest mean over the corpora it applies to; a tie keeps the current default. The winners are the defaults in `src/lakematch/config.py`.

## Candidate generation — `candidates.method`

Candidate recall at an equal pair budget: every method's proposals are ranked by the same IDF gram cosine and cut to the budget below; recall = true pairs of VALID left records that survive. `union` = gram_topk + field_blocks. Budget: FEBRL4 5 pairs per left record; BPID 5 pairs per left record; Abt-Buy 5 pairs per left record; Leipzig 10 pairs per left record.

## String similarity — `features.string_similarity`

End-to-end F1 on VALID (95 % bootstrap interval), everything else at its default, candidates from `gram_topk`.

| Choice | FEBRL4 | BPID | Abt-Buy | Leipzig | Mean |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **levenshtein** | 0.9990 [0.997, 1.000] | 0.8079 [0.780, 0.837] | 0.6533 [0.599, 0.710] | 0.8628 [0.851, 0.874] | 0.8307 |
| jaro_winkler | 0.9990 [0.997, 1.000] | 0.7992 [0.772, 0.825] | 0.6848 [0.633, 0.736] | 0.8568 [0.846, 0.868] | 0.8350 |
| both | 0.9990 [0.997, 1.000] | 0.8070 [0.780, 0.835] | 0.6533 [0.599, 0.710] | 0.8639 [0.853, 0.875] | 0.8308 |

Winner: **levenshtein**.

> The highest mean is `jaro_winkler`, but only `levenshtein` may be a default on Spark 4.1.3: D07 forbids a default path that depends on Jaro-Winkler, a UDF before Spark 4.3. It stays available behind `features.udf_features`; the Spark 4.3 watcher triggers the re-decision once it is a built-in.
